findings.title: Restore the source endpoint-difference estimand
findings.detail: The report identifies k B_o-dot B_o, but the frozen R36 contract defines A=k q-s with q=(B_o-B_s)/T_ref, s=dot B_o and k=2cT_ref/D. B is dimensionless; q,s,A share rate units. Dropping B_s and T_ref changes the physical estimand although the numerical matrix [kI,-I] retains rank five. The candidate labels must be bound to q,s, not an unnormalized observer endpoint. A weak endpoint witness with B_o=dot B_o=0, B_s=-1e-4 T, c=T_ref=1,D=2 gives A=1e-4 T while the reported expression gives zero.
findings.minimal_fix: Name and define q,s,k and A consistently in JSON/CSV/prose, preserve delta s=k delta q and distinguish the additional common-endpoint nullspace if B_o and B_s are separately introduced. No new depth moments.

findings.title: Propagate a declared physical remainder norm rather than multiplying two rate scales
findings.detail: The source Fisher eigenvalues have units (uas/year)^-2. The plotted r/sqrt(lambda(F)) is valid when r is a dimensionless whitened-data residual radius; the candidate labels r as a physical PM rate and calls the output an identified-combination radius. That gives squared-rate dimensions and fails unit equivariance. At r=1 uas/year it returns 0.6405874815; converting the same inputs to mas/year produces 6.405874815e-7 rather than the converted 6.405874815e-4. No response or norm was supplied that repairs this scaling.
findings.minimal_fix: Declare an assumed STF5 coefficient-level physical remainder e in A with Frobenius norm <=r in uas/year and propagate it through the identified quotient. Keep statistical whitening distinct. For the saved Gaussian confidence ellipsoid use directional support sqrt(q95*v^T F^-1 v)+r*||v||, centred on saved A_hat; equivalently present the deterministic remainder-only shift r separately. Preserve unbounded null fibres. Retaining r/sqrt(lambda) requires relabeling that auxiliary calculation as a dimensionless whitened residual and cannot replace the required physical-remainder image.

findings.title: Do not classify representable nonzero S as exact zero after norm underflow
findings.detail: The candidate repeats that arbitrarily small nonzero S retains the inverse, but the inherited joint_test branches on np.linalg.norm(S)==0 before its scaling fix. For 1e-200*S_saved all nine entries are nonzero; the norm underflows and returns S_ZERO_DIRECT_MEMBERSHIP with inverse_d null, while a scale-safe inverse is finite with maximum component 1.327797572e198. The existing 1e-8 control passes and does not test this failure.
findings.minimal_fix: Within the new owned consumer, distinguish exact zero using maxabs or elementwise zero and use a scaled inverse/decomposition for representable nonzero S; explicitly reject nonrepresentable inverse outputs. Do not alter the frozen R36 source. Alternatively a precisely declared numerical domain with explicit rejection outside it must replace the arbitrary-small implementation claim; silently returning the exact-zero branch is forbidden.

findings.title: Distinguish seven ambient octupole coordinates from four perpendicular degrees of freedom
findings.detail: At fixed nonzero S the lift is 7x3 of rank three, so its orthogonal complement has dimension four. Calling the perpendicular residual seven-dimensional is misleading; it is a seven-component vector constrained to a four-dimensional subspace.
findings.minimal_fix: Use seven-component residual with a four-dimensional perpendicular subspace for nonzero S; all seven are perpendicular at S=0.
